title: wkharness source sandbox suffix: cheap edits only -<word>/gitignored; ROOT merges
desc: Spec for the cheap-model source-edit sandbox -- which files a cheap tier (haiku/flash/*-mini) may edit (-proto/-probe/any -<word> suffix, or gitignored scratch) and the ROOT merge duty. Impl: Test-WkHarnessSourceIsSandboxed + Test-WkIsCheapAgentSession in wkharness-common.ps1. Bidirectional pair of harness-active-model-scoping P7.
steps: RULE: cheap model tiers (haiku / flash / *-mini, detected by Test-WkIsCheapAgentSession in wkharness-common.ps1 ~L1168) are SANDBOX-RESTRICTED from editing canonical original source. They may edit ONLY (a) a file whose leaf ends in a hyphenated suffix segment, or (b) a gitignored target (scratch, free).
